title: Security Deposit: Accepted Forms of Non-Cash Security
content:
A Security Deposit is ordinarily met in cash. For the kinds marked below, the company accepts a non-cash instrument for the full required amount in place of cash.

| Security Deposit kind | Surety bond for the full required amount | Irrevocable letter of credit for the full required amount | Written guarantee by another Lakeshore customer with satisfactory history | Guarantee released after (months of satisfactory payment) | Interest paid on non-cash security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential New Service Deposit | Not accepted | Not accepted | Accepted | 12 | No |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit | Not accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted | 0 | No |
| Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit | Not accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted | 0 | No |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | Not accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted | 0 | No |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | Accepted | Accepted | Not accepted | 0 | No |
| Large Power Service Deposit | Accepted | Accepted | Not accepted | 0 | No |

## Standards

1. A surety bond or an irrevocable letter of credit is accepted only for the Medium Commercial Service Deposit and the Large Power Service Deposit, and only for the full required amount.
2. A third-party guarantee, given in writing by another Lakeshore customer with satisfactory history, is accepted only for the Residential New Service Deposit, and it is released after 12 months of satisfactory payment. The release figure is 0 for every kind that does not accept guarantees.
3. No interest is paid on non-cash security for any kind: instruments earn nothing.

## Applying the table

| Kind and proposed security (hypothetical) | Accepted in place of cash? |
|---|---|
| Large Power Service Deposit, irrevocable letter of credit for the full required amount | Yes |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit, surety bond for the full required amount | Yes |
| Small Commercial Service Deposit, surety bond | No |
| Residential New Service Deposit, written guarantee by another Lakeshore customer with satisfactory history | Yes |
| Residential Reestablishment Deposit, written guarantee | No |
